diffusionModel.description: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, Comfy-Org's int8_convrot quantisation of Qwen's own checkpoint. Only this checkpoint: the fixed sigma schedule in graph.py is Turbo's, and a base or third-party DiT here would run the wrong configuration with nothing to say so.

textEncoder.description: Qwen3-VL 8B. Qwen-Image 2.1 uses this rather than the 2.5-VL encoder the edit arm loads, and it is also the model that rewrites a prompt when the enhancer is on.

vae.description: Qwen-Image 2.1's own VAE. Its latent is 64 channels at a sixteenth scale, so the 2511 VAE will not do.

outputDir.description: Root that every job output path is confined to.

inputDir.description: Root that a job's reference images are confined to. ComfyUI is given this as its own input directory, so a reference is named relative to it and nothing outside it can be read.

scratchDir.description: Where ComfyUI keeps its own output, temp, user and database files. Kept apart from the viggle arm's, which shares the same ComfyUI checkout.

weightDtype.description: How the transformer is held. The int8 file is already quantised: default keeps it so. fp8 only makes sense for the bf16 Turbo file.

textEncoderDevice.description: cpu keeps Qwen3-VL off the card entirely. It also makes the prompt enhancer far slower, because the enhancer is that same model generating text.

vramMode.description: dynamic is ComfyUI's own memory manager, which streams whatever will not fit. The rest pin its behaviour.

attention.description: Attention backend. sage and flash need their own packages installed into the shared venv.

reserveVram.description: GiB left to the desktop compositor. Too little and Windows starts evicting the model behind ComfyUI's back.

cacheMode.description: What ComfyUI keeps between jobs. ram is its default; none re-runs every node each time, which throws away the cached prompt encode a batch depends on.

kvCacheDevice.description: Where Qwen-Image 2.1 keeps the attention prefix cache. auto uses spare VRAM then RAM; off recomputes the prefix every step, which is slower but rules the cache out.

kvCacheDtype.description: Prefix cache precision. int8 halves it at about bf16 accuracy; int4 quarters it and roughly doubles the per-step error.

extraArgs.description: Extra ComfyUI command line flags, split on whitespace and passed through verbatim.
